Printed loss on continuing operations (62.96) for 2025 and (86.33) for 2024; profit attributable to the group (58.92) and (79.35). Ties: the stored Profit before tax of (49.78) and (73.15) less the stored tax expense of 13.18 and 13.19 equals (62.96) and (86.33). The statement prints no finance cost or finance income for either year, so Net Finance Costs stays empty rather than zero.
